name: Mondrayn
detailed_description:
Mondrayn is a challenging JRPG game with a dark fantasy atmosphere in a surreal dystopian world where you have to survive and become stronger.

Find a variety of artifacts, create equipment, explore locations filled with danger and secrets. Collect and lead a team of heroes, each of whom has his own character and goals.

You will have to explore the danger-filled distorted world. Look for useful items, create and improve unusual equipment, study opponents to survive. You will meet a variety of characters and stories, the plot of which directly depends on your actions. Gather a team, become stronger and go on the road to adventure.

Features:

  • Hardcore tactical combat system.

    Chop off limbs, knock off armor, maim enemies - or become food for those who are stronger. Save every bandage, every arrow. Only the calculating survive here.

  • The atmosphere is surreal dark fantasy.

    Afterlife deities raising the dead, creepy rituals, mutated machinery of the past and much more.

  • Non-linear quests with multiple endings.

    Decisions have consequences. Some will survive. Someone will die. Someone will become something worse.

  • Companions.

    Find allies. Everyone has their own goals, their own traumas, their own dark paths. Some may betray you. Others may save you.

  • Explore and Craft.

    Gather resources, craft gear, upgrade weapons, or you'll return to the world of the dead.

  • Creepy art and eerie soundtrack.

    Stylish and unique pixel graphics combined with creepy music create the atmosphere of a real nightmare.

Welcome and good luck at the Festival of Rebirth!
